The outer circle further sub-divides "Virtual Characters" into 5 categories: "Comic Characters" (light blue, approximately 30%), "Movie Characters" (light blue, approximately 10%), "Teleplay Characters" (light blue, approximately 5%), "Novel Characters" (light blue, approximately 10%), and "Game Characters" (light blue, approximately 10%). The "Real Characters" category is sub-divided into 7 categories: "Scientists" (light green, approximately 2%), "Artists" (light green, approximately 3%), "Athletes" (light green, approximately 4%), "Writers" (light green, approximately 3%), "Musicians" (light green, approximately 3%), "Actors" (light green, approximately 3%), and "Influencers" (light green, approximately 2%). The chart does not include a legend, but the categories are labeled directly on the slices. The slices are visually grouped by their parent category, with "Virtual Characters" and "Real Characters" being distinct from "Custom Characters". The proportions of the slices are not explicitly labeled, but can be estimated based on their size.

DESCRIPTION: The chart is a nested pie chart comparing the proportions of different character categories, with 13 slices in total, divided into "Custom Characters" (red, approximately 15%), "Real Characters" (green, approximately 20%) with 7 sub-categories, and "Virtual Characters" (blue, approximately 65%) with 5 sub-categories, labeled directly on the slices and visually grouped by their parent category.
